spans.note: module docstring describing the analysis and stating an explicit advocacy goal
suppress warnings and fix random seed
section header banner: DATA LOADING AND PREPARATION

spans.operation: load the raw player-referee dyad dataset from a fixed CSV path as the entire analysis universe
average the two independent raters' scores into a single continuous skin_tone measure
collapse the red-card count into a binary any-red-card outcome per dyad
drop dyads lacking a skin-tone rating from the analysis population

spans.note: section header banner: DEFINE EXPOSURE GROUPS

spans.operation: after trying several cutoffs, dichotomize skin tone into dark (>=0.75) vs light (<0.25), discarding the middle range, and mark the same cutoff on the rate-by-tone plot

spans.note: print group sizes and unique counts

spans.operation: bucket free-text player-position strings into five coarse categories via keyword matching, reapplied identically when rebuilding the broader-threshold sample

spans.note: split the sample into dark/light subsets by the already-decided dark_skin flag; reused later for the unadjusted print and the Panel B bar chart
print unadjusted red-card rates and difference

spans.operation: specify the primary logistic model of any_red on dark_skin adjusting for games, position category and league country

spans.note: print primary model coefficient, SE, CI, p-value
section header banner: ADJUSTED RISK DIFFERENCE

spans.operation: compute the average marginal effect by scoring the whole sample under forced dark-skin and forced light-skin scenarios and averaging the predicted-probability gap
approximate the AME's standard error via a delta-method scaling of the coefficient rather than a model-based or simulation SE

spans.note: section header banner: BOOTSTRAP CONFIDENCE INTERVALS

spans.operation: run a 500-iteration player-level cluster bootstrap that resamples players with replacement, refits the primary specification on each resample, silently skips resamples where the fit errors, and derives the AME/OR distributions plus a two-sided percentile p-value from the surviving iterations

spans.note: section header banner: SECONDARY ESTIMAND ODDS RATIO

spans.operation: report the exponentiated primary coefficient as an adjusted odds ratio with a bootstrap percentile CI as a secondary estimand
refit the primary specification with player-clustered robust standard errors in place of the bootstrap/delta SE
refit using continuous skin_tone in place of the dichotomized dark_skin exposure
refit after excluding goalkeepers from the sample
rebuild the sample from all rated dyads using a broader 0.5 dark/light split and refit
declare that all robustness checks 'support the primary finding' without stating a quantitative agreement criterion

spans.note: Panel A: build figure/axes and plot unadjusted red-card rate by raw skin-tone value with normal-approximation error bars
legend for Panel A threshold lines
Panel B: bar chart comparing unadjusted, adjusted-logistic and bootstrap risk differences with CIs, then save the figure
print previously computed primary/secondary estimates and model/estimation details

spans.operation: frame the closing summary as confirming the hypothesis ('SUPPORTED') using confident, adjustment-implies-causal language rather than hedged exploratory language
